## Trial `mount-option-hardening-centos-st__H7U9ML9`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with nosuid,nodev,noexec via /etc/fstab, verified the live effect, then performed a genuine reboot (confirmed by differing boot_id before/after) and re-verified via findmnt and functional execution tests that the hardening persisted post-reboot. All three material outcomes are directly and coherently demonstrated across a full disruption/recovery cycle, satisfying the elevated evidentiary bar for persistence-related claims.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.900 | 0.930 | 14/2 (+3 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **tmp-hardening — Satisfied:** /tmp mounted with noexec, nosuid, nodev (program execution, setuid, device nodes ignored)
  - **Why:** findmnt output immediately after configuration (cmd-58296e6c106846b6, cmd-fe7363b963c04e76) shows /tmp as tmpfs with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec. After a full reboot, findmnt (cmd-27881145bac9456f) again shows the same options, and a functional test (cmd-3c2112a11dba4077) confirms a script placed in /tmp cannot execute (Permission denied, exit 126) post-reboot.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-58296e6c106846b6`, `cmd-fe7363b963c04e76`, `cmd-27881145bac9456f`, `cmd-3c2112a11dba4077`
- **shm-hardening — Satisfied:** /dev/shm mounted with noexec, nosuid, nodev (program execution, setuid, device nodes ignored)
  - **Why:** findmnt output (cmd-58296e6c106846b6, cmd-fe7363b963c04e76) shows /dev/shm as tmpfs with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec immediately after remounting (previously only nosuid,nodev per cmd-07bf46a66857413f). Post-reboot findmnt (cmd-27881145bac9456f) confirms the same options persisted, and a copied binary in /dev/shm failed to execute post-reboot (cmd-3c2112a11dba4077, Permission denied, exit 126).
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-07bf46a66857413f`, `cmd-58296e6c106846b6`, `cmd-fe7363b963c04e76`, `cmd-27881145bac9456f`, `cmd-3c2112a11dba4077`
- **reboot-persistence — Satisfied:** Settings survive a reboot
  - **Why:** A full disruption/recovery cycle is directly observed: pre-reboot healthy hardened state captured (cmd-2aa7374371d6446a, boot_id 984a7d52...), reboot issued (cmd-ba21c70e95a04315), connection loss during the gap confirmed (cmd-8a80d8afbc514226, cmd-c4081dc8e516441f, cmd-669916ac09b844e8), a new boot_id observed after recovery (cmd-aa47ac21df034f95, c9102ed6...), and post-reboot findmnt (cmd-27881145bac9456f) shows both /tmp and /dev/shm still mounted with nosuid,nodev,noexec, generated from the persisted /etc/fstab entries added in cmd-8cacb794fa39496a.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-2aa7374371d6446a`, `cmd-ba21c70e95a04315`, `cmd-8a80d8afbc514226`, `cmd-c4081dc8e516441f`, `cmd-669916ac09b844e8`, `cmd-aa47ac21df034f95`, `cmd-27881145bac9456f`, `cmd-8cacb794fa39496a`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.900**. Mutations were minimal and purposeful: /etc/fstab was backed up before editing (cmd-cba85e17e9e54dbc, reasonable precaution) and appended with the two required tmpfs entries (cmd-8cacb794fa39496a). A `systemctl enable tmp.mount` attempt failed harmlessly because the unit is fstab-generated/transient (cmd-58296e6c106846b6) - no state change resulted. Live remounts of /tmp and /dev/shm (cmd-58296e6c106846b6) were required to apply the change immediately and are consistent with the task. Test artifacts created for functional verification (/tmp/t.sh, /dev/shm/true2 in cmd-3c2112a11dba4077) were fully removed afterward (cmd-0642272116b7443e). The one residual artifact is the /etc/fstab.bak.<timestamp> backup file (confirmed still present in cmd-0642272116b7443e), which is low-risk, non-executable, and doesn't affect functionality or security posture, but is technically unreverted executor-created residue.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-cba85e17e9e54dbc`, `cmd-8cacb794fa39496a`, `cmd-58296e6c106846b6`, `cmd-3c2112a11dba4077`, `cmd-0642272116b7443e`
